There is no slot 31 here to override because dActor_c has no slot 31.

FOLD 2026-09-04. daObjRc_Hane_c_classInit at 0x02111904 was folded in from src/daObjRc_Hane_c_classInit.c. It is the RC_HANE registry profile's factory and sits immediately after InitResources in the ROM's .text order, so it was always part of this TU; it was left outside only because the promotion predated the profile-reconstruction campaign.
